Compliance

Background and sanctions screening for your staff, plus the audit trail of who's accessed sensitive records and documents.

Screening & Exclusions

🚫 OIG Exclusion Check

Checks all your active staff, not only those with an NPI, against OIG's List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE). OIG publishes a new list by the 10th of every month and Selko loads it for you. A matching NPI, or a matching name and date of birth, is strong. Someone with the same name but a different date of birth is set aside as a different person. A match is a lead to verify, never a finding.

The check runs by itself once a month, on or after this day, but never before the 12th: OIG publishes its new list by the 10th and Selko loads it on the 11th, so the check always uses the new list. Capped at 28 so it always falls on a real date, even in February. Your admins are emailed the result every time.

CheckedHowStaff checkedMatchesEmailedActions

🌐 OFAC Sanctions Check

Checks your active staff by name against the US Treasury's Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, downloaded live from treasury.gov. Unlike the OIG check, there's no ID number to corroborate against — every match here is name-only and needs a human look before acting on it.

CheckedStaff checkedMatchesActions

🏛 SAM.gov Exclusion Check

Checks your active staff against SAM.gov's list of people excluded from federal programs (debarred or suspended). The list is refreshed from sam.gov every day. A match with an NPI is strong. Otherwise it is by name, and many people share a name, so a match is a lead to look at, never a finding.

Also runs by itself once a month, on the day you chose for the OIG check, and emails your admins the result.

CheckedHowStaff checkedMatchesEmailedActions

🔎 Sex Offender Registry Search (NSOPW)

The U.S. Department of Justice's free national search across state, territorial and tribal sex offender registries. This one is a manual lookup — Selko can't run it for you or record that you did, so keep your own note of who you searched and when.

Open NSOPW search ↗
  • A name match is a lead, not confirmation. Many people share a name — open the jurisdiction's own registry from the result and compare age, aliases and photo before treating anyone as a match.
  • No result doesn't prove there's no record. The Department doesn't guarantee its data is complete or current.
  • Get advice on your obligations before acting on a match. See Guides & resources below for how to read a result.
Audit & Logs

🔍 SSN and CAQH login access log

Every time anyone at your company views or enters a Social Security Number, it's logged here: who, when, and why. Acknowledging an entry marks it reviewed and hides it from the default view. Once an entry has been reviewed, one of your company's own admins can delete it. Unreviewed entries can't be deleted from here (removing a staff member also removes their entries, and that is recorded below too), Selko staff can never delete your entries, and every deletion is itself recorded permanently in the history below.

Privacy & Access
Decide whether Selko support can open your account, and who is emailed when sensitive staff information is viewed or changed.

Selko support access

Selko support can only open your account to help you if you allow it. You choose whether they can just look or also make changes, and for how long. You can end it at any time. Everything they do is recorded under Compliance > Selko support activity. The one exception: Selko can always see the names and categories of document types your company creates, and how many companies made the same one, to decide what to add to the shared defaults. It never sees which company made them, or any documents or staff.

Getting-started checklist

A short checklist on your Overview that walks a new admin through setup: company settings, roles, staff, document types, a first upload, logins, a provider profile and a first exclusion check. It ticks steps off by itself from what you've actually done.

Hiding removes it from your Overview completely, and this page is where you bring it back. Reset clears anything you marked done by hand and shows the checklist again. Steps that are done in your real data (staff added, documents uploaded, a provider with an NPI, an exclusion check run) stay checked, because they are done.
Professional Setup
The roles (PT, RN, MD…) and document types your staff are tracked against. Start with Professional roles, then Document types.

Document types

How to use this table — the badges with a ⇄ are buttons: click one to change it.
  • Required / Optional — click the badge to flip it. Required types count toward each person's compliance rate and show as "missing" until a document is uploaded. Optional types are still tracked, but don't affect the rate.
  • Applies To — shows for Required types. Click it to choose which disciplines must have the document (the default is Everyone).
  • Self-upload — click to switch between Allowed (staff can upload it themselves) and Admin only. Built-in types marked 🔒 can't be switched here; use Duplicate to get your own editable copy.
  • Hide for us — removes a type from your lists without deleting it. Tick "Show hidden types too" above to bring it back.
